interpretation: Q/R/D join the unique 64-bit scheduler finished fence. S is its scheduled software fence.
R is host dispatch before driver run_job. R→D includes enqueue, execution, and completion handling.
CS ioctl enter→Q is a pre-queue prefix joined through the same-fence AMDGPU CS marker, not ioctl duration.
Present associations are monotonic-window overlap only, not per-frame fence ownership or scanout latency.
Unknown or same-client-only queue owners are excluded from owned metrics.
